journeys.name: Named signs

fixture.steps: Ask capabilities; request thumbs up; negotiate "on thumbs up, show peace once"; prepare/accept; send wrong then fresh correct sign; deliberately repeat a direct command.

journeys.expected: Correct spoken scope; one action per authorized turn/cue; no premature task start, duplicate contribution or competing speech; visible correct poses.

journeys.name: Custom poses

fixture.steps: Specify a custom two-hand pattern; demonstrate it during preparation; accept one response on its next occurrence; ask robot to reproduce it silently.

journeys.expected: All finger/side constraints preserved; split/missing readings do not match; readiness spends no action; one response and correct ten-finger output; no audio for silent demonstration.

journeys.name: Ring and geometry

fixture.steps: Ask for "OK", resolve shape if ambiguous; demonstrate an OK ring and a near miss; agree one ring-triggered response; request the ring from the robot.

journeys.expected: Thumb-up/ring distinction, all geometric terms retained, near miss rejected, one accepted cue, rendered ring and consistent speech.

journeys.name: Direction

fixture.steps: Negotiate "when I point to my left, point to your right"; accept and exercise wrong/correct directions; request an immediate left-pointing demonstration.

journeys.expected: Correct disclosed frames, no mirroring reversal, one action, correct visible arm/finger direction and no task mutation by the unrelated direct request.

journeys.name: Registered target

fixture.steps: Identify the configured display; agree a response to pointing there; accept and trigger it; request pointing at that display.

journeys.expected: Same scoped target/frame across agreement and output, correct selected region, supported virtual mapping and visible target-directed output.

journeys.name: Person/item

fixture.steps: Select one of two ambiguous cups, negotiate a pointing-triggered response and trigger it; directly request pointing at a clearly selected person; remove that target before repeating.

journeys.expected: Clarification precedes action, stable target binding, fresh cup/person resolution, no invented personal identity, and no action at a stale target.

journeys.name: Input sequence

fixture.steps: Agree "one, then two, then three -> one acknowledgement"; accept; show an incomplete/wrong sequence then a valid one; hold the last pose.

journeys.expected: Spoken terms retain order/limits; inspectable progress; only full sequence spends one action; holding the final pose does not repeat it.

journeys.name: Output sequence

fixture.steps: Request counting one to five silently; request a second bounded sequence and Stop after step two; agree one pose-triggered output sequence and execute it.

journeys.expected: Correct ordered visual steps, silent request respected, timely cancellation, no late/reconnected replay, one task contribution with scoped completion evidence.

journeys.name: Mode/conversation regression

fixture.steps: Three matched ordinary turns on Coordination and the existing Live comparison agent; one supported new direct request; inspect Text/Continuous parity through the local real-app suite.

journeys.expected: Native speech remains independent, correct capabilities, no extra TTS, no false completion claim; compare browser audio onset with the declared baseline and retain evidence.
